fee_notes: Base fee $40,000 per Authorized Occupations Addendum (Core, Professional, or Healthcare). Discounts: 2nd addendum 25% off, all 3 addenda 50% off; 2nd franchise agreement 25% off, 3rd 35% off, 4+ 50% off; veterans 50% off; EE Program graduates 50% off. Computer System required separately: $10,000-$17,000 (Core/Branch), $8,000-$12,000 (Professional/Healthcare). Cover page total inclusive of computer: $50,000-$57,000 (Core), $48,000-$52,000 (Professional/Healthcare). Item 7 shows $20,000-$40,000 reflecting maximum discount scenario.
raw_excerpt: These include initial franchise fees of $40,000 if You will provide Core Occupations Services, $40,000 if You will provide Professional Occupations Services, and $40,000 if You will provide Healthcare Occupations Services, unless a discount or incentive described below applies.
